correctness.rationale: Conditional on the fBm path, independent uniform-in-panel indicators have exact variance sum Delta_j^2 p_j(1-p_j); bivariate normal sign-disagreement = arccos(rho)/pi and self similarity yield V=n^-2gamma sum a_j. The covariance identity gives 1-rho=[|t-s|^(2H)-(t^H-s^H)^2]/(2s^Ht^H). The smooth correction is O((h/A)^(2-2H)) relative to the leading singular term uniformly on j-th distant panel; hence a_j~gamma^(H+2) j^(2gamma-H-2)/[pi(H+1)(H+2)]. Positive-series asymptotics prove the polynomial, logarithmic and convergent regimes on the correct sides of 2gamma=H+1, for every fixed 0<H<1 and gamma>0. Differentiation of K gives unique gamma*=1+H/2; independently checked stationary derivative at H=1/4,1/2,3/4. Finite quadrature code is supplemental, not basis of infinite asymptotics.

originality.rationale: Known stratified Monte Carlo optimal-density theory by Abramowicz and Seleznjev applies to quadratic-mean continuous locally stationary processes and requires uniform positive-order quadratic-mean Hölder control at t=0. X_t=1_{B_t^H>0} has no quadratic-mean limit there and does not satisfy their global hypotheses, so their general optimal density cannot by itself prove the exact three power-mesh regimes or critical logarithm. Altmeyer estimates occupation via deterministic equispaced Riemann observations, not randomized uniform time draws; other cited works pursue trajectory recovery or occupation laws. Best-of-knowledge originality PASS for the singular-endpoint MSE trichotomy, full exact series and sharp grade selection.
